before_snippet.title: Would You Enter a Sick Relative's Room During the Plague?
before_snippet.description:
When someone in your home fell ill during an epidemic, keeping your distance could mean leaving them without care. Protecting yourself reduced personal risk, but someone still had to bring water, provide food, and care for the sick.

#BlackDeath #PlagueHistory #MedievalHistory #Shorts
